strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Dynamic Resolution using Fast Flux DNS

analytics.name: Analytic 1331
analytics.guidance: Identify repeated DNS resolutions where the same domain name returns multiple IPs in short succession, combined with low TTL values and high query volume from unusual processes. Correlate with process lineage (e.g., Office apps spawning abnormal DNS lookups).

tuning.description: Number of unique IPs returned per domain in a short window
Adjust correlation timeframe for fast flux detection (e.g., 5–10 minutes)

analytics.name: Analytic 1332
analytics.guidance: Monitor resolver logs and auditd events for domains resolving to a rotating set of IPs within very short TTL intervals. Correlate high query rates from non-browser applications (e.g., python, curl).

tuning.description: Minimum TTL value considered suspicious (e.g., < 60 seconds)
External TI feed to exclude benign CDN or load balancer behavior

analytics.name: Analytic 1333
analytics.guidance: Use unified logs to identify processes issuing repeated DNS queries where the resolved IP addresses change frequently within very short TTL values. Correlate with outbound network traffic to validate C2-like patterns.

tuning.description: Rate of IP churn per domain to trigger detection
Flag if domain was registered recently (e.g., < 30 days)

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Rapid domain-to-IP resolution changes for same domain

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Unexpected apps generating frequent DNS queries

analytics.name: Analytic 1334
analytics.guidance: Monitor ESXi syslog and esxcli outputs for abnormal DNS resolver behavior, such as frequent domain-to-IP changes or unauthorized modifications of DNS settings used by management agents. Correlate domain lookups with short TTL values.

tuning.description: Whitelist of expected DNS resolvers configured on ESXi
Known trusted external domains for hypervisor services

log_sources.name: esxi:syslog
log_sources.channel: Frequent DNS resolution of same domain with rotating IPs
